title: Quick Cucumber Salad
summary: Smashed cucumbers salted for ten minutes, then tossed in a garlicky soy, vinegar and sesame dressing. No heat, no knife skills, ready in fifteen minutes. The first recipe to try if you have never cooked.

ingredients.name: persian cucumber
ingredients.notes: or 2 english cucumbers; thin-skinned, seedless types work best

ingredients.name: chili crisp
ingredients.notes: or a pinch of red pepper flakes

steps.instruction: Rinse the cucumbers and trim the ends. Lay each one on the board and press down firmly with the flat side of a wide knife or the bottom of a jar until it cracks open along its length.
success_cues: Cucumber splits into craggy, uneven pieces with lots of exposed flesh
warnings: If smashing with a knife, keep the blade edge pointed away from you and your fingers clear of the flat side.
steps.creator_note: Smashing instead of slicing is what makes the dressing cling. Rough, torn surfaces grab far more flavour than clean cuts.

steps.instruction: Tear or cut the smashed cucumbers into bite-sized chunks. Put them in a colander, toss with the salt and leave them to drain for 10 minutes.
success_cues: Beads of water appear on the cucumber and a small puddle drips out of the colander
Pieces feel slightly limp and bend without snapping

steps.instruction: While the cucumbers drain, stir together the garlic, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil and sugar in a large bowl until the sugar dissolves.
success_cues: No sugar grains left when you drag a spoon across the bottom of the bowl
Dressing tastes sharp and salty on its own; the cucumber will dilute it

steps.instruction: Shake the colander, then gently squeeze handfuls of cucumber to get rid of the extra water. Do not rinse. Add the cucumber to the bowl of dressing.
success_cues: Cucumber pieces look slightly translucent at the edges and no longer drip
steps.creator_note: Squeezing out the water is what keeps the salad crunchy instead of soupy after ten minutes on the table.

steps.instruction: Toss well so every piece is coated. Add the chili crisp if using and toss once more. Taste a piece; add a splash more vinegar if it is flat or a pinch of sugar if it is too sharp.
success_cues: Dressing clings to the torn surfaces instead of sitting in the bottom of the bowl
A piece tastes salty, sour and nutty all at once

steps.instruction: Pile into a serving bowl and top with the sesame seeds and cilantro. Serve within 30 minutes while it is still crunchy.

creator_notes: This is the recipe I give people who say they cannot cook. There is no heat and nothing can burn; the only skill is tasting and adjusting at the end.
It is best eaten the day it is made. Leftovers turn watery but still taste good spooned over rice.
dietary_warnings: Contains soy and sesame. Soy sauce usually contains wheat; use tamari for gluten-free. Raw garlic is strong; halve it if serving children.
